title: ErrorCode
description: TASK-103 (revised): Unified error code taxonomy aligned with arch v2 §8.7 (13 categories). Slashed rows from v2 (RateLimited/Timeout, UserCancelled/TookOver) unified into single ErrorCategory variant per row to keep count at 13; the underlying distinction is preserved via evidence_ref and message_for_model content. New codes require ADR (schema change).

evidence_ref.description: Snapshot id, log line, or audit event ref for the failure context. Per v2 §8.7 "每条错误带 code、message_for_model、message_for_user、hint、evidence_ref".

categories.message_for_model: Model output did not parse as valid JSON / tool call (JSON schema violation, hallucinated tool name, missing required field).
categories.message_for_user: The model produced a malformed tool call.
categories.hint: Re-prompt the model with the schema; cap retries at 2.

categories.message_for_model: Model provider returned 429 rate-limit or network timeout.
categories.message_for_user: Model service is rate-limited or unreachable.
categories.hint: Exponential backoff; if budget exceeded, downgrade model tier or escalate.

categories.message_for_model: Tool input arguments failed JSON Schema validation (missing required, wrong type, value out of range).
categories.message_for_user: The tool call arguments are invalid.
categories.hint: Re-prompt the model with the tool schema; do not auto-retry.

categories.message_for_model: Policy rule denied this action (rule_id + reason in evidence_ref).
categories.message_for_user: This action is blocked by a policy rule.
categories.hint: Read the policy reason; request human approval if appropriate.

categories.message_for_model: No target matched the supplied TargetDescriptor.
categories.message_for_user: Cannot find the target window or element.
categories.hint: Re-poll the descriptor after a short delay; escalate to self-heal or human.

categories.message_for_model: Multiple targets matched the descriptor (samples in evidence_ref).
categories.hint: Provide more selector detail or handle on_first/on_ambiguous policy.

categories.message_for_model: Target process unresponsive (no alive samples in evidence_ref).
categories.hint: Wait and retry with watchdog; escalate to human if repeated.

categories.message_for_model: Capability not supported by adapter (see evidence_ref for adapter_id).
categories.message_for_user: This operation is not supported on the target.
categories.hint: Check capability-matrix; pick a different adapter.

categories.message_for_model: Postcondition check failed after action; see evidence_ref.
categories.message_for_user: The action did not achieve the expected outcome.
categories.hint: Inspect state; rollback if needed; report to human per on_violation.

categories.message_for_user: The agent needs OS permission to control this app.
categories.hint: Guide user to grant permission; suspend automation until granted.

categories.message_for_model: Transient failure (focus jitter, momentary lock); safe to retry.
categories.message_for_user: A temporary issue; the action will be retried.
categories.hint: Short backoff (100-500ms) then retry; do not escalate on first occurrence.

categories.message_for_model: User cancelled or took over (details in evidence_ref).
categories.message_for_user: The action was interrupted by user input.
categories.hint: Do not auto-retry; respect cancellation; if took-over, re-sync state then resume.

categories.message_for_model: Fatal agent error (Host crashed, storage corrupted).
categories.message_for_user: A fatal internal error; please report this incident.
categories.hint: Capture diagnostics and file a bug with full audit-event trace.
